Backend and DevOps for Android developers

Build a bookmark service, survive a lost reply, ship a replacement and recover the data. Finish with a backend change and an operations incident report.

Start learning Browse modules

Course outline

  • Build the backend3 puzzles

    Trace one write from the phone into durable storage.

    1. Which process answers the phone? Follow one bookmark from a client to the process that owns it.
    2. Did the first write happen? Make a lost reply safe to retry.
    3. Can two clients prove the rule? Test a retry through the running service and read what survived.
    Check what you already know
  • Operate the service2 puzzles

    Release, observe and recover the same service.

    1. Where does the data live during a release? Replace the running service while keeping its bookmark file.
    2. Alive, ready, or serving the wrong thing? Diagnose a storage failure and rehearse recovery.
    Check what you already know
How the course works

Every puzzle is open from this outline. The check at the end of a puzzle unlocks its next button and saves your progress in this browser.
